episodes.synopsis: On her first day of school, Minami Tani, a girl who is obsessed with bread, befriends her classmates Yuu Aizawa and Fuyumi Fukagawa.
episodes.title: I Made Bread Buddies

episodes.synopsis: Fuyumi introduces her friend, Noa Sakura, who looks and acts childlike despite being the same age.
episodes.title: This Is a Weapon

episodes.synopsis: The girls visit Fuyumi's family bakery, where they try some of their special breads before trying their hand at baking their own.
episodes.title: Fuwa Fuyu Bakery

episodes.synopsis: The girls go to the school store to try and obtain a limited ciabatta sandwich.
episodes.title: In Pursuit of the Fabled Bread

episodes.synopsis: Yuu talks about her dreams of becoming a manga artist.
episodes.title: Yuu-chan's Dream

episodes.synopsis: The girls try to help Fuyumi lose weight by making miniature melon pan.
episodes.title: Fuyumi-chan's Diet

episodes.synopsis: The girls visit Noa, who is sick with a cold, and meet her little sister Ami.
episodes.title: The Sick Noa-chan!

episodes.synopsis: Noa visits the Guillame French bakery, where she befriends a girl named Mai Kawai, prompting some jealousy from Fuyumi.
episodes.title: The New Bakery

episodes.synopsis: The girls hold a maid café at their school's culture festival, where Mai pays a visit.
episodes.title: The Cultural Festival

episodes.synopsis: Mai visits the FuwaFuyu bakery, where she and Fuyumi find some common interests.
episodes.title: Intriguing Girl

episodes.synopsis: The girls go to the pool to teach Noa and Yuu how to swim, unaware that Mai can't swim either.
episodes.title: Let's Swim

episodes.synopsis: The girls are invited to stay over at Mai's vacation home.
episodes.title: Slumber Party at the Vacation Home

episodes.synopsis: The girls recall all the memories they made thanks to their love of bread.
episodes.title: Pan de Peace!
